scope: Independent review of the published static report against accepted TCP and UDP primary summaries and report evidence links.

numeric_check.compared_against: median and inclusive linear Q1/Q3 values in summary-tcp.json and summary-udp.json

statistical_semantics.tcp_throughput: Median of seven matched round rates; upload and download are separate.
statistical_semantics.udp_throughput: Median of seven matched round rates; upload and download are separate.
statistical_semantics.established_rtt: Median of seven per-round medians from 256 established 64-byte application request/verified response observations per round.
statistical_semantics.fresh_first_response: Separate setup/first-response metric, median of seven per-round medians from eight fresh-flow samples per round.
statistical_semantics.udp_loss: Median of seven per-round loss percentages by direction; explicitly distinguished from aggregate loss.
statistical_semantics.pooled_latency: Described only as supplemental; report says pooled 1,792 RTT and 56 setup observations per group do not replace the primary estimators. No pooled statistic is presented as the primary table.
statistical_semantics.combined_score: No combined direction or cross-protocol score is presented.

evidence_links.raw_sample_links: Every result row links its seven protocol/case/product sample JSON records.

content_review.whole_product_and_dependency_confounding: Explicitly disclosed; original GSO older base/dependency/SS2022 differences and integrated batching-era lifecycle/protocol/stream/auth/teardown work are stated.
content_review.cpu_roles: Candidate relay CPUs 2,3 / GOMAXPROCS=2; fixed client, gateway, measurement and echo CPUs 0,1 / GOMAXPROCS=2; potential shared-support bottleneck disclosed.
content_review.fwupd: TCP running-service preservation failure explicitly records fwupd.service disappearance (31 to 30 listed units), unknown cause, and warns against inferring benchmark causality or claiming all services unchanged. UDP service snapshots are separately stated unchanged.
content_review.pid_boundary: Report states contemporaneous manual/container Xray PID/command identity was not captured, and historical PID evidence is not a contemporaneous preservation check.
content_review.udp_workload_boundary: Loss-aware windowed workload with reliable same-route control and exact 100 ms drain/cutoff is labeled not raw/unpaced UDP capacity and not comparable with TCP capacity.
content_review.local_rendering: HTML parsed; inline CSS only, no script/image/SVG dependencies. Relative evidence targets resolve in the delivered task root.

result: No coverage, numeric, displayed-rounding, broken-relative-link, or reviewed statistical-semantics mismatch found.
